raw_truth_resolution: Raw diagnostic disagreement does not revoke later exact product/configuration owner corrections. Keep both evidence layers.

demand.meaning: No newer fetched_at was observed; do not upgrade the prior held evidence using an import date or this capture date.

proposals.title: Shoulder armor
proposals.user_intent: Compare decorative shoulder pieces available as selectable purchases.
proposals.unique_value: Show the exact shoulder option and its contents on each card; distinguish a single piece, pair and outfit. Link to the existing PDP selector without implying that every photographed piece is included.
proposals.decision: Prepare a type-hub brief from current selectable options. Commercial intent, distinct designs and inventory policy still require review.
proposals.url_note: New candidate path. The broader linked /collections/armor path has a different scope; do not redirect it to shoulders or award the same primary cluster automatically.

proposals.title: Body and fashion harnesses
proposals.user_intent: Compare a harness as an actual selectable garment, with clear contents.
query_exclusions: how to style a body harness
proposals.unique_value: Identify the harness configuration and precise included pieces; distinguish full outfits from individual harness choices. Do not treat all belts or chokers as harnesses.
proposals.decision: Prepare a narrow type-hub brief; verify fashion/costume intent before claiming the broad body-harness cluster.
proposals.url_note: Reuse the existing linked slug harness. Architecture B2 harnesses was provisional. No second harnesses page or redirect is deployed by this proposal.

proposals.title: Burning Man outfits
proposals.user_intent: Select FEYA pieces for an event with accurate composition and ordering information.
query_exclusions: what to wear to burning man
festival outfits without specific event intent
proposals.unique_value: A reviewed edit with specific suitability rationale, component choices and current production/shipping limits; no protective, weather or arrival guarantees.
proposals.decision: Hold membership. A title-derived world label is a discovery hint only. Obtain product-scoped suitability evidence through the existing Product OS review.
proposals.url_note: Prefer the existing linked burning-man-looks slug when the route is implemented. No live route or canonical-history evidence currently establishes burning-man-outfits as a replacement.

proposals.title: The shop
proposals.user_intent: Browse the FEYA catalog and narrow the choices.
proposals.unique_value: Existing approved catalog, filters and product cards; future crawlable pagination in the same visual composition.
proposals.decision: Preserve current visual structure and 243 product identities. Bind an existing or newly approved portfolio ID only through the normal registry workflow.

proposals.title: How to choose pieces and a costume set
proposals.user_intent: Understand exactly which pieces a selector option includes before ordering.
proposals.unique_value: Use reviewed FEYA examples for a standalone piece, grouped option and full set; explain photograph versus selected contents and link back to the exact PDP.
proposals.decision: Prepare a utility brief with current offer examples. Keyword Planner volume is not a prerequisite for this buyer-help page; use the existing utility-rationale exception and CQA review.
proposals.url_note: Proposed route only; current admin collection planner remains the preparation surface.
